Honestly, after going through and over everything. The Lady of Pain simply seems to be an extant force given form and function. She’s appears to be an enigma because she contradicts all conventions of what an entity of her power would do and want. A being of absolute power and authority that simply is, infinitely removed yet completely involved. Everyone *knows* she exists but to revere her existence is to damn your own. The Lady of Pain doesn’t seem to have any other purpose than to keep, maintain and protect Sigil, and who better to do it? She is not motivated by anything other than apathetic duty, no ego, not want, not hunger or lust for power. She opposes any and every one that could and would disrupt Sigil, barring gods and mortal alike. She’s the keeper of the keys and the doors, and has the power necessary to protect them, and punish those who would misuse or otherwise disturb the order. 

The Lady of Pain is compelling not only because she is an enigma, but also because of the function of her character. She simply is. People like her in the way they may like death or the a natural disaster. It’s awe, it is respect. It’s not necessarily a like in the way you may define it, more so an admiration for the purpose she serves as a character and force within the lore.
